name: Nestor Makhno
role: Ukrainian anarchist insurgent commander and exile writer
summary: Makhno advocated a stateless communist society administered by workers and peasants through free councils and federations. He combined opposition to party dictatorship with support for disciplined, voluntary revolutionary armies; wartime policies also imposed coercive penalties on counterrevolutionaries.
